name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All 9 trials scored exactly 0 on dev and also 0 on train success. That held across recipes (1, 2 and 4 epochs, entropy from 0.003 to 0.02), heads (pooled, footprint-conv, per-layer and dense) and the slow-DONE fix. Small differences are not what is going on: something stops any success at all. The task says the world may not behave as described, so the likeliest blocker is a mismatch between action indices and cells. Every aligned head assumes a top-left anchor and the stated y/x order. The dense head could have learned any mapping, but it probably learns too slowly on about 400k samples. A cheap hedge is a learned local window for each brick type: a 3x3 conv covers top-left, centred and bottom-right anchors, and adding transposed features covers a y/x swap. The legality mask also reveals the anchor convention and orientation, so feeding it in as an input should help. These are last-round bets aimed at getting any nonzero score.
